changes: Core pure typed admission is shared by desktop and headless adapters while they retain their runtime lock through reservation.
Stopping and recovery-required ownership can never be reused as a successful duplicate connect.
Only a healthy published User intent may be reused; Startup and Automatic owners are busy.
Headless automatic startup now actually supplies Startup origin through a private command-dispatch entry point.
Repository recovery, restore, mutation, shutdown, orphan recovery, unpublished starts and conflicting network ownership all gate admission before reuse.
Existing desktop Chinese error presentation and v1/Tauri shapes are preserved; process, generation, retry and cleanup ownership remain in adapters.
compatibilityNotes: An unresolved recovery owner from another profile now returns typed RecoveryRequired instead of generic NetworkConflict; the existing regression expectation was updated to this shared semantic classification.
Headless published desired intent can be reused before its child is spawned, but a desktop credential worker without a published instance is only a busy reservation.
limits: Full scripts/verify-local.zsh and long-running stress are coordinated by the root agent after source stabilization.
No host VPN/network state was modified by these regression tests.
No Windows runtime acceptance is implied by this checkpoint.
